sentences.text: **Scheme Brief Description:** The objective of this scheme is to provide financial assistance to pilgrims undertaking a pilgrimage to the Sindhu River in the Ladakh region of India. Under this scheme, selected beneficiaries receive reimbursement of their travel expenses, up to a maximum of ₹10,000/- per pilgrim.
**Who is this for:** Individual; Category: Travel & Tourism; Sector: Tourism in India

**Detailed Description:** The scheme &quot;Sindhu Darshan Pilgrimage Scheme&quot; was introduced by the Devasthan Department, Government of Rajasthan, on 1st April 2016. The objective of this scheme is to provide financial assistance to pilgrims undertaking a pilgrimage to the Sindhu River in the Ladakh region of India. Under this scheme, selected beneficiaries receive reimbursement of their travel expenses, up to a maximum of ₹10,000/- per pilgrim. > **Total Number of Beneficiaries** The scheme is limited to 200 pilgrims per year. If there are more applicants than available slots, selection will be by lottery.

**Benefits / Assistance:** - Reimbursement of 50% of actual travel expenses, up to a maximum of ₹10,000 per pilgrim. > **Note:** Payment is made via online bank transfer or through account payee cheque or demand draft, depending on departmental conditions.

**Application Process:** > **Application Process** **Step 1:** The interested applicant downloads the [application form](https://devasthan.rajasthan.gov.in/Files/sindhu_darshan_2024.pdf) from the official website. **Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attested, if required). **Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents to the Assistant Commissioner’s Office, Devasthan Department. > **Note:.** - The application must be submitted within 2 months of pilgrimage completion. - The application submitted no later than December 31, 2024. > **Selection &amp; Approval Process** - Only individuals selected by the Devasthan Department are eligible for the grant. - After completion of the pilgrimage, submit proof of expenses and certified documents to the Assistant Commissioner. - The Assistant Commissioner will verify and forward all valid applications to the Commissioner, Devasthan Office, Udaipur. - If applications exceed 200, a computerized lottery will be conducted. - In case of families applying together, only 3 members per family will be considered.
